claim_boundary: This is a precommitted fallback, not evidence that fine-tuning is required or will pass. It is triggered only if the frozen universal-CHGNet feasibility or publication-heldout domain gate fails. A passing fallback applies only to exact-composition LLZTO over the tested structure and 650-900 K coordinate domain; every transport trajectory used for publication must then be regenerated with the final fine-tuned weights.
preregistration_note: Frozen before the first final-setting feasibility DFT label, before any feasibility or heldout model error, and before any fallback coordinate, label, checkpoint, or model weight existed.

trigger.hard_rule: A universal-domain pass closes this branch as complete-not-triggered. Either frozen domain failure activates the same full fallback from the 12 development labels; the original 30 publication-heldout labels, if they exist, remain diagnostic and are never used for fallback training, checkpoint selection, threshold selection, or final testing.

energy_reference_alignment.method: minimum-L2 AtomRef shift at fixed exact composition
energy_reference_alignment.fit_data: training partition only during checkpoint selection; every non-heldout training record during final refit
energy_reference_alignment.rule: Compute the pretrained interaction contribution as predicted energy minus the old AtomRef contribution. Shift the old AtomRef weights by the minimum-L2 vector parallel to the exact-composition fraction vector so that mean(shifted AtomRef + pretrained interaction) equals mean DFT energy per atom. Freeze AtomRef after this deterministic shift.
energy_reference_alignment.scope_limit: Because every training structure has the same composition, the shifted AtomRef is not validated for any other stoichiometry.

transfer_learning.energy_label: QE total energy divided by atom count, in eV/atom
transfer_learning.stress_label: The repository positive-tension stress in GPa is multiplied by -10 before StructureData, which converts VASP-style kbar back by -0.1.
transfer_learning.trainable_scope: last atom convolution plus downstream readout/output layers
transfer_learning.checkpoint_score: max(validation energy MAE/0.015 eV atom-1, force-component MAE/0.10 eV A-1, stress-component MAE/0.25 GPa); choose the earliest minimum

validation_rule.hard_rule: Both selected frames in each of the five diagonal strata are validation records; all 12 feasibility records and the other 40 expansion records train checkpoint selection.

final_training_phase.refit_rule: After choosing the earliest minimum normalized validation score, reload the untouched pretrained model, realign AtomRef on all 62 non-heldout records, and train for exactly selected_epoch_plus_one epochs on all 62 records.

fresh_publication_test.acceptance_rule: Apply unchanged aggregate and robustness thresholds from the locked universal-domain analysis protocol. No fallback threshold may be relaxed after seeing results.

release_and_rerun.hard_rule: A passing fresh publication test releases only campaigns whose manifests embed the final fine-tuned state-dictionary hash and model artifact hash. It never creates the universal-model g2-release-v1 token.
required_reruns: all downstream mechanism, statistics, experiment, publication, manuscript, attestation, and evidence-audit products

sources.role: official CHGNet fine-tuning documentation and stress/energy-label conventions
